explanation: I searched Mathlib for `coeff_mul_sumElim` and for `sumElim` under RingTheory/MvPowerSeries and Algebra/MvPolynomial. I found nothing stating the coefficient of a product of MvPowerSeries over `α ⊕ β` at `a.sumElim b`. The only nearby declaration is `Finsupp.image_sumElim_product_antidiagonal`, which is an ingredient of the current proof. Deriving the statement from it also needs `Finset.sum_image`, an injectivity argument and `Finset.sum_product`, so it is not a one- or two-line derivation.
